description: The build base a kit is compiled on (what gripforge_third_party_kit_build uses): the contract and the structures version, the pinned Rust toolchain with its components and target, the profile, the options of each mode, the locked crate versions, the links an isolated kit may take — and whether this machine is ready for it (toolchain.ok, toolchain.missing, toolchain.install: the one rustup command). Guide: gripforge_docs { topic: "kit-third-party" }.

install.description: true: install what is missing with rustup (the default toolchain is not changed).

sdk.description: Absolute path of the kit SDK: the kit-sdk folder of the GripForge CLI, or a GripForge checkout. Default: GRIPFORGE_KIT_SDK, else the SDK of the gripforge CLI found on PATH.

name: gripforge_third_party_kit_socle
title: The build base of the kit modules
